title: Actions by context (server, service, client, screen, data action, preparation) and their typed variables (inputs, outputs, locals, call arguments)

capabilities.title: ServerAction (IServerAction)
capabilities.summary: Declare a server action with `logic` (kind server: signature, locals and steps; Start/End, links and layout generated) or raw verbs under @espace; maintain it by `IServerAction:<Name>`: usages before delete, replace to repoint callers by key, rename keeps callers bound by key.
capabilities.guidance: A screen saves through a server action wrapper (CreateOrUpdate inside it), never by calling the entity action directly. Do not name an aggregate `Get<Entity>s`: a filter renames it and expressions break. Replace needs the same signature. The action's typed inventory (inputs, outputs, locals) is logic.variable; flow nodes are logic.flow.

recommends.when: the action's parameters or locals change

alternatives.when: the caller is another app (remote, loosely coupled)

read.route: get/dump IServerAction:<Name> (dump lists parameters, locals and nodes)

preconditions: callers are execute-action nodes in other actions or screen actions

odc.scope: an inherited action with one real caller inside a foreach; two callers (server action and screen action); a new action whose only consumer is the call inserted into an If branch

o11.scope: two callers (server action and screen action) listed before replace and delete; a new action whose only consumer is the call inserted into an If branch

create.route: logic kind server (compact) or create @espace IServerAction + parameters + nodes (raw)
preconditions: compact: closed keys; declared inputs/vars must be used and outputs assigned
an existing name is refused unless replace:true
a private action without consumer raises an unused-action warning: declare it in expectedMessages

o11.scope: the call stays bound by key; a caller node with the automatic name (equal to the action's) is renamed with it. A node the author renamed, and <Node>.<Output> expressions of a server action, were not measured on O11

preconditions: same signature
consumers keep their key; the old action ends with 0 consumers

o11.scope: one and two callers repointed

preconditions: the copy takes the platform suffix and has no consumers; rename it afterwards

capabilities.title: ServiceAction (IServiceAction)
capabilities.summary: `logic` kind service (or create @espace IServiceAction) is the remote entry of a module's logic: its callers are remote, so usages inside the module are normally 0; it typically delegates to a private helper action.

capabilities.guidance: Local callers use a server action; the service action is the remote entry. Consuming it from another app is front C (reference.*).

capabilities.summary: IClientAction under @espace built with raw verbs (signature, nodes, often a JavaScript node); called by IExecuteClientActionNode; `Function` makes it usable in expressions.

route.operation: create @espace IClientAction; parameters; nodes; set Function; IExecuteClientActionNode in the caller

capabilities.title: ScreenAction (IScreenAction)
capabilities.summary: A screen action lives in its screen (`create IScreenAction` under the screen, or `logic` kind screen with `owner`); address it by the screen path. Its binding to the UI is front B (ui.*); here are the action's own operations.

capabilities.guidance: Reactive/Mobile screen actions return nothing: put returned values in a client action. A screen submits through a server action wrapper (logic.server-action).

capabilities.title: IInputParameter, IOutputParameter, ILocalVariable, IArgument
capabilities.summary: Read an action's typed inventory with get/dump of the action (parameters and local variables with DataType); declare them in `logic` (inputs/outputs/vars: name, type, mandatory, default) or create IInputParameter/IOutputParameter/ILocalVariable; then set DataType/IsMandatory/DefaultValue/Description, move, rename, delete by path; a call argument is `<callNode>/arg:<Param>`. Reset typed variables: assign each variable its type's neutral value; skip the excluded.
capabilities.guidance: Types: basic (Text, Integer, Long Integer, Decimal, Boolean, Date Time...), `<Entity> Identifier`, `<Entity>` (record), `<Structure>`, `<X> List`. Adding an input to an action with callers creates an empty argument in every caller: make it optional with a DefaultValue, or fill each argument. Check usages before changing a DataType or deleting.
